_readme: S730 title hunt (elumen group), 2026-11-25, round 1. Sam asked on 2026-11-25 for each college's printed local subject titles (the catalog's heading for each course subject code), which decide a local code's common subject and unblock the 88 stray M-ID codes (r-no-mid-on-a-stray-code-sam-2026-11-25; kb/subject_title_hunt/README.md). S712 (run 45161535251) found Bakersfield's eLumen courses view prints every subject as 'Name - CODE'. This read loads this catalog's start page and its courses view, rendered, and prints the menu links that name a subject or department, so a session files the headings without reading every course.  No model call, writes nothing.

questions.subject_index: Where the catalog prints each course subject code with its name (a courses view, a subject list, or the menu's headings), and the names as printed.
